verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs say every published MCP server gets a typed TypeScript SDK generated from its tool and trigger schemas. A documented Vercel AI SDK integration handles OAuth, token refresh and multi-server tool aggregation, so developers can build in code rather than implementing MCP directly. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript (e.g. Python), a named core client SDK package with install and usage docs, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
